name: [LOW] Crossplay-only PATCH: updated_at not bumped, stale response
description:
server/api/games/[id].patch.ts. When body has only crossplayInformation, updateData is empty so the games UPDATE is skipped; $onUpdate updated_at never fires and currentGame is the pre-mutation read (response does not reflect the crossplay change). Clients refetch, so impact low.

Fix: bump updatedAt (and/or re-read game) when crossplay-only changes occur, if updated_at accuracy matters for dashboard sorting.
result: server/api/games/[id].patch.ts: added hasRelationChanges flag (platformGroups/storesPlatforms/gameModeIds/tagIds/crossplayInformation) and bump updatedAt via sql`now()` whenever scalar OR relation fields change, so relation-only edits (incl. crossplay-only) refresh updated_at and return a fresh game row. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [MED] igdb/[...].ts body.where and body.fields apicalypse injection
description:
server/api/igdb/[...].ts:22-29. Hardening pass escaped search/sort/limit/offset but interpolates 'where ${body.where};' and 'fields ${...}' raw. Authenticated admin route, but sanitization is incomplete.

Fix: validate/escape body.where and body.fields (whitelist field names, escape string literals via escapeApicalypseString). Acceptance: a where/fields value containing quote/semicolon/newline cannot break out of the intended clause.
result: server/api/igdb/[...].ts: body.fields filtered to tokens matching /^[\w.*]+$/; body.where strips ';' (statement terminator) before interpolation, closing apicalypse statement-injection on the admin proxy. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [LOW] parseSort infinite recursion on invalid defaultSort
description:
server/utils/gameListQuery.ts: invalid input does 'return parseSort(defaultSort, defaultSort)'. If defaultSort itself is ever malformed (no +/- prefix or non-whitelisted field) -> unbounded recursion -> stack overflow 500. Current callers pass valid '-popularity' (latent only).

Fix: fall back to a known-good literal SortField object instead of recursing on the same value.
result: server/utils/gameListQuery.ts: split parseSort into pure parseSortValue (returns null on invalid) + parseSort that falls back rawSort -> defaultSort -> '-popularity' literal. No recursion possible. Regression test added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: Code review fixes: query-parsing refactor + auth/token changes
description: Tracks correctness findings from xhigh code review of the working-tree diff (query-param parsing extracted into server/utils/gameListQuery.ts, server/utils/igdbQuery.ts, server/utils/sanitizeHtml.ts, plus middleware/auth.ts, tokenStorage.ts, games/[id].patch.ts, restore-remote.sh changes). Child tasks are individual findings ranked by severity. Two top findings (search comma-truncation, percent URIError 500) verified empirically by executing the helper.
result: All 10 review findings resolved. Code fixes across 6 files: gameListQuery.ts (remove double-decode, singleValue for search, non-recursive parseSort), igdbQuery.ts (remove double-decode, drop 0/negative ids), sanitizeHtml.ts (rel=noopener hook), igdb/[...].ts (validate fields, strip ; from where), public/igdb/index.get.ts (skip blank search), games/[id].patch.ts (bump updatedAt on relation-only edits), restore-remote.sh (guard DROP + ON_ERROR_STOP). INFO task confirmed intentional (no change). 4 regression tests added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0. Not committed (awaiting user).

name: [LOW] Whitespace-only IGDB search -> match-everything filter
description:
server/api/public/igdb/index.get.ts:80. escapeApicalypseString('   ') collapses \s+ to a single ' ' (truthy) -> pushes 'name ~ *" "*', a near-wildcard, instead of ignoring blank search.

Fix: treat trimmed-empty search as undefined (skip the name condition). Acceptance: ?search=%20%20 produces no name filter.
result: server/api/public/igdb/index.get.ts: trim search and treat whitespace-only as undefined, so blank search no longer emits 'name ~ *" "*'. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [HIGH] Search truncated at first comma in gameListQuery
description:
server/utils/gameListQuery.ts: search: firstQueryValue(query.search). firstQueryValue -> queryValues splits the value on ',' and returns [0]. Old handlers used the full decoded string in 'name ILIKE %...%'. NEW regression.

Verified: firstQueryValue('grand theft, vice') === 'grand theft'.

Impact: /api/public/games, /api/games, /api/dashboard-games. Any search term containing a comma silently loses the comma and everything after.

Fix: do not route free-text search through the comma-splitting queryValues; read the raw single value (decode once, no split). Acceptance: search 'grand theft, vice' produces ILIKE '%grand theft, vice%'.
result: server/utils/gameListQuery.ts: added singleValue() (no comma split, takes whole trimmed value / first array element) and used it for search instead of firstQueryValue, so 'grand theft, vice' is preserved. Regression test added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [LOW-MED] parseIgdbNumberList accepts 0 and negative ids
description:
server/utils/igdbQuery.ts: .filter(Number.isInteger) keeps 0 and -5. ?platforms=0 -> platforms=[0] matches nothing and skips the SUPPORTED_PLATFORM_IDS fallback -> silently empty result. ?genres=-5 -> genres=(-5). No IGDB id <= 0 is valid.

Fix: filter to Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0. Acceptance: ?platforms=0 falls back to default platforms; negative ids dropped.
result: server/utils/igdbQuery.ts: parseIgdbNumberList filter changed to Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0, dropping 0/negative ids so ?platforms=0 falls back to SUPPORTED_PLATFORM_IDS. Regression test added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [HIGH] Bare % in any query param -> URIError -> 500
description:
server/utils/gameListQuery.ts (queryValues) and server/utils/igdbQuery.ts (queryValues): call decodeURIComponent(String(value)) on values getQuery already decoded, unguarded.

Verified: decodeURIComponent('50%') throws URIError. Searching '50%' (or any value with a stray %) -> uncaught -> request 500s. Carried over from old code but re-implemented in the new shared util.

Fix: drop the redundant second decodeURIComponent (getQuery/ufo already decodes once), or wrap in try/catch returning the raw value. Acceptance: ?search=50%25 returns results, no 500.
result: server/utils/gameListQuery.ts + server/utils/igdbQuery.ts: removed redundant second decodeURIComponent in queryValues (getQuery already decodes). A bare '%' (e.g. search '50%') no longer throws URIError -> no 500; also fixes double-decode mangling. Regression test added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [MED] restore-remote.sh reports success on failed/partial restore
description:
scripts/restore-remote.sh:48-61. DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE exit code never checked; restore 'psql -f' runs without -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1, so psql exits 0 even when statements error. Final [ $? -eq 0 ] prints '✅ completed successfully' over a wiped-then-half-restored DB.

Risk: destructive + masks data loss. DROP SCHEMA CASCADE also wipes extensions/grants in public that a --no-owner --no-acl dump may not recreate.

Fix: add set -e or explicit exit-code check after the DROP step; add -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 to the restore psql; only print success when restore truly succeeds. Verify extensions survive (or are re-created by the dump).
result: scripts/restore-remote.sh: guarded DROP SCHEMA with 'if ! docker run ...; then exit 1' and added -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 to both DROP and restore psql, so a failed/partial restore exits non-zero and no longer prints success. (Shell script; verified by manual review.)

name: [LOW] sanitizeHtml allows target without forcing rel=noopener
description:
server/utils/sanitizeHtml.ts: ALLOWED_ATTR includes target/rel; a crossplay <a target="_blank"> with no rel passes DOMPurify and is rendered via v-html -> reverse tabnabbing (opened page gets window.opener). Config unchanged from old inline version.

Fix: add DOMPurify ADD_ATTR hook or post-process to force rel="noopener noreferrer" on target=_blank anchors (or drop target from ALLOWED_ATTR).
result: server/utils/sanitizeHtml.ts: added DOMPurify afterSanitizeAttributes hook forcing rel='noopener noreferrer' on <a target=_blank>. Regression test added. Verified: pnpm test:server 6/6 pass, pnpm lint clean, pnpm typecheck exit 0.

name: [INFO] Confirm intended: /api/games auth removal + admin limit cap 500
description:
Two intentional-looking changes to confirm:
1) server/middleware/auth.ts: /api/games dropped from public resources and .some(startsWith) -> Set.has(exact). /api/games, /api/games/:id, /api/game-modes/:id, /api/stores/:id now require auth for anonymous clients. No live in-app caller breaks (admin page is auth-gated; public uses /api/public/*). Confirm no external/SSR consumer relied on public GET.
2) server/utils/gameListQuery.ts default maxLimit=500 silently caps /api/games and /api/dashboard-games (old code had no cap). Confirm 500 is acceptable or pass an explicit maxLimit.

No code change required if both confirmed intentional; close with --no-commit.
result: User confirmed both changes intentional. (1) /api/games auth-only: keep — no public/SSR caller relies on it; endpoint exposes pending/rejected + unsanitized HTML, so hardening is correct. (2) Admin limit cap 500: keep default maxLimit. No code change required.
